name: Malta Permanent Residence Programme (MPRP)

requirements.blocker_text: Minimum capital assets of EUR500,000, of which at least EUR150,000 must be financial assets (alternative bracket: EUR650,000 total capital with at least EUR75,000 in financial assets).
Must purchase qualifying residential property in Malta for at least EUR375,000, retained for a minimum of 5 years.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying residential property at or above the threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: EUR60,000 non-refundable administrative fee; EUR37,000 government contribution; EUR500 per person residence-card fee; EUR7,500 per additional adult dependant (excluding spouse).
EUR2,000 donation to a registered local NGO in the philanthropic, cultural, scientific, artistic, sport, or animal-welfare sectors.
Minimum capital assets of EUR500,000, of which at least EUR150,000 must be financial assets (alternative bracket: EUR650,000 total capital with at least EUR75,000 in financial assets).
Alternatively, rent qualifying residential property in Malta for at least EUR14,000/year, retained for a minimum of 5 years.
requirements.fix_path: Sign a qualifying rental agreement at or above the threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: EUR60,000 non-refundable administrative fee; EUR37,000 government contribution; EUR500 per person residence-card fee; EUR7,500 per additional adult dependant (excluding spouse).
EUR2,000 donation to a registered local NGO in the philanthropic, cultural, scientific, artistic, sport, or animal-welfare sectors.

evidence_required.document: Proof of capital assets (EUR500k/EUR650k bracket with matching financial-asset composition)
Police conduct certificate and security vetting clearance
Proof of stable resources without reliance on social assistance

outcome.duration_length: indefinite residence status; residence card issued for 5-year renewable periods

sources.title: Residency Malta Agency -- Malta Permanent Residence Programme (MPRP): capital-asset thresholds, administrative/government fees, property purchase/rental thresholds, NGO donation, 4-generations-per-application, 5-year residence card

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Malta's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. The source explicitly states: 'The MPRP grants permanent residence in Malta and is distinct from the separate legislative provisions governing citizenship' -- no direct/automatic citizenship pathway is described. leads_to_citizenship is nonetheless set true because MPRP time counts as ordinary legal residence toward mt_naturalisation's general aggregate-residence track, not because MPRP itself confers any accelerated or dedicated citizenship route; citizenship_after_months left null accordingly. work_rights and study_rights set to 'none': the tier-1 page does not describe this as an employment or study status, consistent with its design as a passive-investment residence permit (not independently confirmed as an explicit prohibition, but no work/study authorisation is described). Programme allows 'up to four generations in one application' per the source -- an unusually broad family-inclusion design compared to most other countries' investment-residence routes in this dataset. MPRP beneficiaries separately obtain an 'Economic Self-Sufficient' residence-card renewal permit via Identita (EUR100 fee) -- not modelled as its own route since it is a follow-on administrative permit contingent on already holding MPRP (or GRP/Malta Retirement Programme/citizenship) status, not an independent path. physical_presence_requirement left null: no minimum physical-stay-in-Malta requirement was specified in the source, beyond retaining the property for 5 years.
